Title: Hydroponic Kale: pH, EC, Light & Harvest Guide
Description: Hydroponic kale: pH 5.8, EC 1.5–2.1, light at 17 mol/m²/day, cool 69/56 °F air. Baby leaf in about 13 days; full plants 4 weeks after transplant. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic kale, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
